title: German-Style Pork Belly Bake
description: A hearty, comforting German-inspired pork belly dish, slow-cooked to perfection. The creamy sauce and tender meat make for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Season the pork belly with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Heat the oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium heat.
Sear the pork belly until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pan and set aside.
Add the sliced onion, carrot, and potato to the pan and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the brown sugar and stir to combine.
Return the pork belly to the pan and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the pan from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the pork belly with the vegetables and sauce spooned over the top.
